report_text: App logs me out randomly every few minutes
Can create account with password shorter than the stated minimum
Users can log in with an old password after changing it
Logout button doesn't clear session on shared device
Sent messages don't show up for the recipient until app restart
Read receipts show 'seen' even when the other person hasn't opened the chat
Blocked users can still send messages that appear in the inbox
Deleted tasks reappear after refreshing the task board
Task comments section doesn't notify assignees when someone replies
Kanban board columns don't sync task status changes in real time
Changing display name doesn't update it in old chat messages
Profile visibility toggle (public/private) doesn't actually restrict access
Deleting account from profile settings doesn't actually delete data
Refund request submitted twice charges the card twice
Free trial doesn't convert to paid plan automatically at expiry
Saved card details disappear after updating expiry date
Dark mode toggle doesn't apply to modal popups
Notification bell icon shows a count but the dropdown is empty
Offline mode doesn't sync changes once connection is restored
Accessibility screen reader skips over button labels
